record.issue_text: PUT /admin/customize/embedding is a no-op that renders the serializer without persisting anything, returning 200 success while no update occurs

adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb`, the `update` action does not apply any params or persist anything; it simply `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)` where `@embedding` is an `OpenStruct` built in `fetch_embedding`. The route `put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"` exists, and the client controller action `saveChanges()` calls `this.get('embedding').update({})`, so a PUT will return a successful serialized response while performing no update.
